english:
Fourth Sunday of Advent [Yisnakats]. Canticle [Harts] of the Day of Resurrection. Midday Psalm 64 [65].
"Praise is due to You" (Kez vayel e). Prophet Isaiah 38:1.
"In those days..." to verse 8: "...the shadow." Epistle Hebrews 1:1. "Long ago..."
"...in many parts..." to verse 14: "...salvation."
Alleluia, according to the tone [i dzaynen]. Gospel Luke 17:1.
"And He said to His disciples..." to verse 10: "...to do, we have done."

Monday. Of the Holy Patriarchs: Ignatius, and Addai, and Maruthas the Bishop. Blessing [Orhnutyun] of Martyrs. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [ddz]: "Who participated" (Ork haghordetsan). Magnificat [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [ddz]: "Who didst invite beforehand" (Or hraviretsyer zyarrachagoyn). Midday Introit [Zhamamut]: "The Patriarchal" (Zhayrapetakanun). Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 3 [gz]: "The leaders and the teachers" (Zarajnords yev zvardapets). Psalm 131 [132]. "Your priests" (Kahanayk ko). Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 5:1. "Then the righteous man..." to verse 8: "...beneficial." Prophet Jeremiah 6:16. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 21: "...shall perish." Epistle 1 Corinthians 3:9 [4:9]. "...it seems to me..." to verse 16: "...be to me [imitators of me]." Alleluia. "Priests" (Kahanayk). Gospel Mark 9:32 [33]. "He came to Capernaum..." to verse 37: "...sent me."

Tuesday. Of the Holy: Theopompus the Bishop, and Theonas the Martyr, and the four soldiers: Bassus, Eusebius, Eutychius, and Basilides. Canticle [Harts] of Martyrs. Midday Psalm 131 [132]. "Your priests" (Kahanayk). Proverbs 24:1. "My son, do not envy..." to verse 12: "...knows all things." Prophet Jeremiah 15:19. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 20: "...says the Lord." Epistle Hebrews 12:1. "Therefore, since we..." to verse 7: "...God [deals] with you." Alleluia, according to the tone [i dzaynen]. Gospel Matthew 10:26. "For there is nothing..." to verse 33: "...who is in heaven."

Wednesday. Canticle [Harts] of Penitence. Midday Psalm 85 [86]. "Save Your servants" (Ketso ztsarays). Epistle Hebrews 2:1. "Therefore..." to verse 10: "...to make perfect." Alleluia, according to the tone [i dzaynen]. Gospel Luke 17:11. "Now it happened as..." to verse 19: "...made you well."

[Rubric code: ՀԿԵՖ-շ-З-ЗԺ-շs]

Thursday. Of the Holy Virgins: Indas, and Domna, and Glycerius the priest, and the Twenty Thousand who were burned in the church of the Nicomedians. Canticle [Harts] of Martyrs. Magnificat [Mankunk] Tone 8 [dk]: "Today with the bodiless" (Aysor und anmarmnotsn). Midday Psalm 65 [66]. "We went through fire" (Antsak mek und hur). Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 3:1. "But the souls..." to verse 8: "...the Lord forever." Prophet Jeremiah 30:18. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 22: "...for a people." Catholic Epistle 1  Peter 4:12. "Beloved, do not be surprised..." to verse 19: "...doing good." Alleluia: "We went through fire." Gospel John 15:17. "These things I..." to verse 25: "...without cause."

Friday. Canticle [Harts] of Rest. Midday Psalm 97 [98]. "All have seen" (Tesin amenayn). Epistle Hebrews 3:12. "Take care, brothers..." to chapter 4:10: "...from his own." Alleluia, according to the tone [i dzaynen]. Gospel Luke 18:1. "And He told them a parable..." to verse 8: "...faith on earth?"

Saturday. Of Holy Abgar, the first-believing and first king of ours. Blessing [Orhnutyun] Hymn [Sharakan]: "Who the heavenly" (Or zyerknavor), with its canons [yur sarokn]. Midday Introit [Zhamamut]: "As after the God-loving king." Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 2 [bz]: "God our Savior" (Astvats Prukich mer). Psalm 20 [21]. "The king rejoices in Your strength" (Ter i zorutyan). Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 6:2. "Listen, kings..." to verse 10: "...do not err." Prophet Isaiah 45:1. "Thus says the Lord God..." to verse 3: "...the God of Israel." Epistle 1 Timothy 2:1. "First of all, then, I urge..." to verse 7: "...in truth." Alleluia. "The king rejoices in Your strength" (Ter i zorutyan). Gospel Luke 7:1. "And it happened, when..." to verse 10: "...healed the sick." In the Evening: Joyous Light [Luys Zvart], and the rest according to the order.

Fifth Sunday of Advent [Yisnakats]. Canticle [Harts] of Resurrection. Midday Psalm 64 [65]. "Praise is due to You" (Kez vayel e). Prophet Isaiah 40:18. "To whom then will you liken..." to verse 31: "...shall not hunger." Epistle Hebrews 4:16. "Let us therefore approach..." to chapter 5:10: "...Melchizedek." Alleluia, according to the tone [i dzaynen]. Gospel Luke 18:9. "He also told this parable to some..." to verse 14: "...will be exalted."

Monday. Of the Holy: Abraham, and Khoren, and the unmercenary physicians: Cosmas and Damian. Canticle [Harts] of Martyrs.
